AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions: Aircheck is a personal-voice drafting, hairline audio editing, and broadcast clip studio. Operational Call Order: - Call 'seedVoiceDraft' first to create or update a plain-text draft session before invoking studio settings or render actions. - Call 'queryGraphPeers' to inspect local X archive contacts relevant to the draft text. - Call 'inspectOfflineVoiceBundle' before 'triggerLocalVoiceSynthesis' to verify that the local VoiceStudio OTA bundle is ready on disk. - Call 'inspectProjectClauses' before 'swapClauseTake' or 'updateGlobalGapScale' in the Hairline Clipper.
